milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The spruce wall sign is at spawn-relative [2, 2, 3]. Since the sign is only ~3.7 blocks from spawn and may be visible in the initial frame, we use max_distance=5 with facing_tolerance=45 to ensure the player is actively looking at the sign (not just passively having it in peripheral view). The tight facing tolerance ensures intentional observation.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The jukebox is at spawn-relative [10, 0, -6] on a cobblestone platform (~11.7 blocks from spawn). Reduced max_distance to 8 blocks to ensure the player has walked at least partway toward the jukebox rather than just turning in place at spawn. The 60° facing tolerance confirms visual observation.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The mineshaft entrance building is centered at spawn-relative [13, 0, -10]. Max distance 10 blocks ensures the player has navigated to the structure (spawn is ~16.4 blocks away, so they must walk at least 6 blocks closer). The 60° facing tolerance confirms they are looking at the entrance.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The visible coarse_dirt blocks are at spawn-relative [13, -4, -12] and [14, -4, -12] on the mineshaft floor. Target set to [13, -4, -12] which is the exposed coarse_dirt block visible when looking at the back wall of the underground chamber. Max distance 5 blocks with 60° facing tolerance ensures the player has descended into the shaft (surface is at Y=0, coarse_dirt at Y=-4, so standing on surface would be ~5.7 blocks away vertically alone).
